call_purpose: You called because some of your students said your lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you hope this gets sorted out.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on desktop Chrome, on Safari and on a phone; the video played on each, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one of the affected students to make a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link; you said you will do this.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you; we were not able to confirm a timeline on the call.
